response.justification: Bogdan brings deep distributed systems experience, strong Python/TypeScript skills, and direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq — aligning well with the role’s AI-native engineering focus. His ownership mindset is evident through founding open-source projects and operational roles, though his limited explicit mention of on-call experience and agile ceremonies raises minor concerns.
